name: ALTER EGO COMPLEX
source:
I had a dream.

A dream that I was in some other place, together with someone special...

"I think... I'll read a book."

A short, spin-off visual novel story for the game ALTER EGO.
translation:
我有一个梦想。

梦见我在另一个地方，和一个特别的人在一起……

“我想……我会读一本书。”

游戏《ALTER EGO》的一个简短的衍生视觉小说故事。
